subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Free __stdcall math helpers (four-component vector interpolation, quaternion construction/interpolation, plane equations, bezier evaluation) plus a large family of thin indirect-dispatch wrappers and thunks that forward arguments through runtime-resolved function-pointer slots in a shared version-adaptive dispatch table after a lazy-init gate call.

summary: Packet wave_007_generic_runtime_objects_14 covers 41 functions in the 0x0050C665..0x0050E540 band. Eleven are straight-line 4-float math helpers (vector cross-product-like combination, cubic Hermite and bilinear interpolation, Euler/axis-angle to quaternion, quaternion multiply/normalize/conjugate/slerp, plane-from-point-normal). The remaining thirty are an indirect-dispatch family: twenty-two wrappers each call the gate sub_50FEA7(1u) and then forward arguments through a distinct global function-pointer slot (0x005D77D4..0x005D78A8), and eight pure thunks forward through the same slots without the gate call. Several slots are shared by a wrapper/thunk pair (0x5D7810, 0x5D7814, 0x5D781C, 0x5D782C, 0x5D7854), indicating the slots are entries of a single runtime-resolved dispatch table. QuadraticBezier consumes the 0x5D7854 slot via the ThunkToFUN0050e174 hop. No function in this packet owns state; all owners are unknown, and the quaternion helpers rely on the shared epsilon test FloatRangeCheck (0x0050C042).

classes.name: Float4VectorMath
classes.responsibility: Straight-line four-component float vector math helpers operating on a caller-supplied 4-float output buffer (base this): cross-product-like combination, cubic Hermite interpolation, bilinear interpolation. All return the output buffer pointer. Grouping is DERIVED from the identical float[4] buffer pattern; these are free __stdcall functions, not a proven C++ class.

classes.name: QuaternionMath
classes.responsibility: Quaternion construction and manipulation helpers operating on a caller-supplied 4-float quaternion buffer (base this, x/y/z/w with scalar at index 3): Euler-angles and axis-angle construction, Hamilton multiply, normalize, conjugate+normalize, spherical linear interpolation. All are free __stdcall functions writing all four output components; the class grouping is inferred from the quaternion arithmetic, not evidenced as a single C++ class.

classes.name: PlaneEquationBuilder
classes.responsibility: Builds a plane equation (ax+by+cz+d=0) from a point-on-plane vector and a normal: copies the three normal components to this+0/+4/+8 and stores the negated dot product at this+0xC as the signed plane constant. Free __stdcall helper; class identity not evidenced.

classes.name: IndirectDispatchWrapper
classes.responsibility: Indirect-dispatch entry points that first call the shared gate sub_50FEA7(1u) (lazy initialization / enable of the version-adaptive function table) and then forward their arguments unchanged through a distinct runtime-resolved function-pointer slot (0x005D77D4..0x005D78A8), returning the indirect call's result. The wrappers share the gate+slot shape, not a proven class hierarchy.

classes.name: IndirectDispatchThunk
classes.responsibility: Thin forwarding thunks that read a runtime-resolved function-pointer slot (0x005D7810..0x005D78A8) and tail-call it without the sub_50FEA7 gate. Several slots are shared with a gate-calling wrapper (0x5D7810, 0x5D7814, 0x5D781C, 0x5D782C, 0x5D7854), so each slot is an entry of the shared dispatch table reachable via both a gate-ensured and a plain path.

classes.name: QuadraticBezierEvaluator
classes.responsibility: Quadratic-bezier evaluation helper that composes two intermediate 4-component control vectors and a blend result by dispatching through the shared math slot ThunkToFUN0050e174 (0x0050E198 / off_5D7854). Class identity is a GUESS grouping of a single function; the dispatched target's semantics live behind the slot.

interfaces.name: IFloatRangeCheck
interfaces.purpose: Shared epsilon range test (FloatRangeCheck at 0x0050C042) used by the quaternion helpers to decide unit-length, near-zero, and degenerate branches: QuatNormalize tests the squared norm against 1.0, QuaternionConjugateAndNormalize tests against 1.0, and AxisAngleToQuaternion tests sin(angle) against 0.0.

interfaces.name: IDispatchTableGate
interfaces.purpose: Gate entry sub_50FEA7 invoked with the constant 1 by every indirect-dispatch wrapper before forwarding; the packet describes it as lazily initializing the shared version-adaptive function table on first call. Its exact side effects and the meaning of the constant 1 are not evidenced.

interfaces.name: IDispatchTableSlot
interfaces.purpose: Runtime-resolved function-pointer slots of a shared version-adaptive dispatch table (0x005D77D4..0x005D78A8). Each wrapper/thunk pair forwards through a distinct slot; shared slots (0x5D7810, 0x5D7814, 0x5D781C, 0x5D782C, 0x5D7854) prove the slots belong to one table. Targets are assigned at runtime and are not statically resolvable.

compatibility_contracts.name: SharedDispatchTableSlotLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement executable must preserve the set of runtime-resolved function-pointer slots at 0x005D77D4..0x005D78A8 and the forwarding shape of the wrappers/thunks that read them. Slots are shared across a gate-ensured wrapper and a plain thunk (0x5D7810, 0x5D7814, 0x5D781C, 0x5D782C, 0x5D7854), so both paths must resolve the same per-slot target.

compatibility_contracts.name: DispatchGateBeforeSlotForward
compatibility_contracts.description: Gate wrappers must invoke sub_50FEA7 with the constant 1 before dispatching through their slot; the gate lazily initializes / enables the shared function table on first call. Preserving the gate-before-forward ordering is required for the table to be usable on the wrapper path.

compatibility_contracts.name: QuaternionFloat4Layout
compatibility_contracts.description: Quaternion helpers read and write a caller-supplied 4-float buffer in x,y,z,w order with the scalar term at index 3 (this+0x0..0xC). All output components are written unconditionally on every path, so a consumer cannot rely on stale output bytes; an external poke to the output does not persist.

compatibility_contracts.name: FloatRangeEpsilonGuard
compatibility_contracts.description: Near-zero / unit-length decisions route through the shared FloatRangeCheck at 0x0050C042. Quaternion normalization treats squared norm within tolerance of 1.0 as already-unit, below 1.1754944e-38 as zero-fill, and conjugate+normalize treats squared norm at or below 1.0842022e-19 as degenerate (zero output). A replacement must preserve these thresholds and the all-four-components-written invariant.

compatibility_contracts.name: MathHelperOutputPointerConvention
compatibility_contracts.description: The straight-line math helpers (vector interpolation, quaternion construction, plane equation, bezier) are __stdcall/free helpers that return the caller-supplied output buffer pointer a1; the output buffer is not owned by the helper. Callers must supply valid output storage and treat the returned pointer as the result address.

unresolved: Purpose and side effects of the gate sub_50FEA7(1u) call are unknown from this packet; the constant 1 is described as an enable flag only by the packet summary, not evidenced.
The runtime targets stored in the dispatch slots (0x005D77D4..0x005D78A8) are assigned elsewhere at runtime and are not statically resolvable; the owner that installs them is unknown.

The callee entries callee:0x0050C762, callee:0x0050C85D, callee:0x0050C97A, callee:0x0050D44F, callee:0x0050D4D9, callee:0x0050D563, callee:0x0050D5F9, callee:0x0050D728, callee:0x0050D93F, callee:0x0050D97E, callee:0x0050DC90, callee:0x0050DD0C, callee:0x0050E174, callee:0x0050E281 and callee:0x0050E313 are packet-generation self-reference artifacts (each equals its function's own address) and are not genuine recursive calls.

Read-only math constants flt_59E43C, flt_59E440, flt_59E450, flt_59E478, flt_5AC9C0, flt_5ADE40 and flt_5ADE44 are listed as read globals but the raw source renders their loads as folded literals (1.0, 0.0, degrees-to-radians scale, 0.00000011920929, 1.1754944e-38, 1.0842022e-19); the global-to-literal mapping is DERIVED and unproven.

The math-helper classes (Float4VectorMath, QuaternionMath, PlaneEquationBuilder, QuadraticBezierEvaluator) group free __stdcall functions by their float[4] buffer arithmetic; common ownership of the this+0x0..0xC buffers across vector, quaternion, and plane objects is not proven (rule: equal offsets on unrelated this pointers are not proof of identical objects).
AxisAngleToQuaternion (0x0050E0D9) degenerate near-zero-angle branch copies a1[0..2] from an uninitialized register-derived pointer v2; the intended copy source is unresolved.
QuaternionSlerp (0x0050E19E) records no callees, so the trigonometric library functions (sin, cos, sqrt, atan2) it invokes are not evidenced in this packet.

QuadraticBezier (0x0050E2AB) reads its blend factor as (1.0-a6)*a6 + (1.0-a6)*a6 in the raw source, an unusual doubling of the (1-t)*t weight; preserved verbatim, not rewritten to canonical 2*(1-t)*t.
Which weight (a5 vs a6) pairs with which edge corner (a3 vs a4) in BilinearInterp4Component (0x0050C9A9) is inferred from formula symmetry, not independently evidenced.
FloatRangeCheck's exact epsilon literals are defined in 0x0050C042, not in this packet; only its use as a near-zero/unit-length guard is evidenced here.
Rotation order implied by EulerAnglesToQuaternion (0x0050DD40) cross-term composition is not confirmed against any caller's convention; no static callers are recorded for the math helpers.
